newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Coryo Merchant seen in US$30 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Coryo Merchant seen in US$30 mln FRCD.

text.p: Coryo Merchant Bank is expected to launch a US$30 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue pending approval by South Korea's Ministry of Finance and Economy, bankers said Thursday.
They said the proposed facility would have a final maturity of 364 days. It would be priced at par to float at 75 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers would be around 85 basis points, bankers noted.
Sumitomo Finance Asia is said to be the arranger for this deal. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2847 4039
